text:
jordan: FYI rolled out the role-matrix refactor a few mins ago, seeing a regression where some viewer accounts can't open the Billing tab on org-scoped projects. repro below. :eyes:

maria: Which deploy tag? @lee @sam please triage.

jordan: Deploy: role-matrix-v2 (infra-bot posted the deploy). Example: user u_9321 on org-44, project p_99 -> clicking Billing returns 403. API call: `GET /api/v1/projects/p_99/permissions?user=u_9321` returns role: "viewer" and perms: ["view_project","view_runs"] — missing any billing permission.

lee: Can you paste raw API response? Also does this affect org admins or only viewers?

jordan: Raw snippet: `{ "user":"u_9321", "role":"viewer", "permissions":["view_project","view_runs"] }`. Admins fine. Looks limited to org-scoped viewers.

sam: Hmm. Migration was supposed to translate legacy alias `legacy:viewer` -> explicit perms including `billing:read`. My bet: migration skipped org-scoped rows because of a missing WHERE clause `scope='org'` in the new mapper.

sec-oncall: Flagging P1. Need audit events for the migrator run + KMS decrypt logs. If role aliases rely on KMS decryption, a transient decrypt failure could leave an alias untranslated and strip billing. @maria can you check audit & KMS logs?

maria: Got it. Audit: `rbac.migration` by svc account `rbac-migrator@infra` at 2026-03-21T04:28Z (run id mr-20260321-773). KMS: one transient decrypt error at 04:29Z for key `projects/ri/locations/global/keyRbac` -> error `DECRYPT_NOT_AUTHORIZED` attempt abc123. Subsequent attempts succeeded.

lee: If migrator saw an auth error it might have marked org as `partial`. Check `rbac_migration` table: `select state, last_step from rbac_migration where org_id='org-44';`

jordan: Query result showed `partial` / `map_permissions`. So migrator didn't finish mapping for that org.

sam: We should avoid ad-hoc SQL if possible. Migrator is idempotent; requeue the job with verbose logs so we can observe KMS behavior and audit entries. If re-run still sits `partial`, then run a controlled fix.

jordan: Repro commands I ran locally:

```
# repro
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/projects/p_99/permissions?user=u_9321" | jq
```

The call shows missing `billing:read`.

maria: @infra-bot please requeue migrator for org-44, verbose=true and attach run id here. Also open a ticket and tag eng-sre + security.

infra-bot: job queued: migrator-reconcile org=org-44 run_id=mr-20260321-773-retry verbose=true (eta ~2m).

lee: Frontend mitigation: I'll soft-render the Billing link for viewers but gate the click with a server-side permissions check so they get a friendly modal asking to request access instead of a hard 403. Flag it behind `billing-gate-soft`. Will push patch in a minute.

sam: Small DB helper to find other affected orgs: `SELECT org_id FROM rbac_migration WHERE state='partial';` returned org-44 and org-77.

sec-oncall: Good. Escalation checklist: 1) re-run migrator, 2) capture KMS audit for the run, 3) if `partial` persists run idempotent backfill only for verified orgs, 4) revert frontend flag after fix. Also capture telemetry on soft-clicks.

jordan: I'm going to re-run the mapper once the job finishes. If still partial I'll run this safe SQL as a last resort (idempotent):

```
UPDATE rbac_roles
SET permissions = array_append(permissions, 'billing:read')
WHERE org_id = 'org-44' AND role = 'viewer' AND NOT (permissions @> ARRAY['billing:read']);
```

sam: Note: role alias expansion path reads encrypted alias from `role_alias` table then expands. If alias decryption failed earlier, a DB-only update is OK but we should prefer fixing migrator + KMS IAM.

maria: Audit entry created: INC-20260321-52. Added migrator run id, KMS transient error, affected orgs list, and assigned to eng-sre oncall.

infra-bot: migrator run mr-20260321-773-retry started at 2026-03-21T04:34Z; verbose logs streaming -> https://logs.redwood.ai/mr-20260321-773-retry

jordan: Update: migrator finished successfully at 2026-03-21T04:56Z. KMS retries succeeded; migrator status for org-44 = `complete`. Re-ran the permission API: user u_9321 now has `billing:read` and Billing tab loads.

lee: Frontend flag pushed and will be toggled off in 1h. Telemetry shows 0 soft-clicks in the interim.

maria: Closing immediate incident but leaving followup items: add migrator retry/backoff, add alert for `partial` state > 5m, add KMS IAM sanity check as part of release gating.

sec-oncall: Postmortem scope: root cause = transient KMS auth error caused migrator partial state. Action items: retry/backoff, integration test for org-scoped mapping, clearer migrator state machine. Assigning owners in the ticket.

jordan: Thanks team. I'll update the ticket with run ids and final verification. :lock:
